# DAE Radau 5th Order

![DAE Radau 5th Order function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/ordinary-differential-equations/09_DAE%20Radau%205th%20Order.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Solves residual R(t,X,dX)=0 using genuine three-stage implicit Radau IIA order 5 and nonlinear Newton solves. A residual is not an explicit derivative and Radau is not BDF. Formula declares residual equations, state names, derivative names and time. State and derivative outputs share Times and shape [time,state]. Regular index-1 DAE baseline; no general higher-index guarantee. X0/dX0 must be consistent; no silent correction. Defaults t0=0,tf=10,atol=[.001],rtol=[.001],initial_step=.01,min_step=1e-8,max_step=1. Tolerance arrays have length 1 (broadcast) or N, nonnegative and not both zero per component. Steps satisfy 0&lt;min_step&lt;max_step with initial_step in bounds. Real f64 coupled systems, not element-wise batch lifting. Vectors are rank 1; matrices and multistate trajectories are actual rank-2 Arrays, not nominal Matrix transport. Values[row,column] is state column at Times[row]. Explicit exception: Linear nth Order Numeric returns only x(t) as a rank-1 Array, without its derivatives. Borrowed Variant user data is opaque to the f64 ODE state profile and may preserve exact common typed payloads, including I128/U128 lexical values, without numeric conversion. No complex transport, implicit batch, dimensional broadcasting or scalar lifting. Formula and FROG Reference are explicitly selected persisted identities sharing one palette artwork. Common connector IDs survive switching instances. ODE Solver and DAE use error in/out clusters; the legacy RK4, CK, Euler and linear functions retain error:i32 (zero means success). ticks:u32 is elapsed calculation milliseconds, not step count or simulated time. Invalid preconditions return empty results; a stopped integration retains accepted rows with an explicit nonzero diagnostic. Resource limits, cancellation, invalid references, nonfinite values and unavailable methods never become plausible zero-valued success. Classic LabVIEW connector documentation and mathematical algorithms; no measured NI runtime parity or confirmed NXG graphical signatures. FROG owns endpoint_policy=clip, long declared identifiers, CK accuracy mapping, repeated-root and Jordan support. Local execution uses the existing immutable authored graph and its owned Highlight worker, through Play with or without the bulb. The public-source LLVM compiled target corridor does not admit these aggregate signatures yet and rejects them explicitly; there is no substituted provider.

<details>
<summary>Résumé français de l’aide Studio</summary>

**DAE Radau ordre 5**

Résout le résidu R(t,X,dX)=0 par un vrai Radau IIA implicite d’ordre 5 à trois étapes avec Newton. Un résidu n’est pas une dérivée explicite ; Radau n’est pas BDF. Formula déclare les résidus, noms d’états, de dérivées et du temps. États/dérivées partagent Times et forme [temps,état]. Socle DAE régulières d’indice 1 ; aucun support général des indices supérieurs annoncé. X0/dX0 cohérents exigés, sans correction silencieuse. Défauts t0=0,tf=10,atol=[.001],rtol=[.001],initial_step=.01,min_step=1e-8,max_step=1. Tolérances de longueur 1 ou N, non négatives et non simultanément nulles par composante. Socle réel f64 : un vecteur est un système couplé, sans batch implicite, complexe ni transport Matrix. Les matrices et trajectoires multi-états sont de vrais tableaux de rang 2 : ligne=temps, colonne=état. Exception : Linear nth Order Numeric renvoie seulement x(t), tableau de rang 1 sans ses dérivées. Les données Variant empruntées restent opaques au profil f64 des états et peuvent conserver des lexèmes I128/U128 exacts sans conversion numérique. Formula/FROG Reference sont des instances manuelles persistées avec les mêmes identifiants des ports communs et le même SVG. ODE Solver/DAE gardent les clusters error in/out ; les anciens nœuds gardent error:i32 (0=succès). ticks:u32 mesure les millisecondes de calcul, pas les pas. endpoint_policy=clip inclut t0 et tf en recalculant le dernier pas tronqué. Dimensions, formules, tolérances, bornes, valeurs non finies, ressources, annulation et convergence produisent un diagnostic explicite. Sources LabVIEW classique, sans parité NI mesurée ni signature NXG confirmée ; les écarts FROG sont documentés. Exécution locale sur le graphe auteur immuable via le worker Highlight, Play avec ou sans ampoule. Le corridor cible compilé LLVM ne prend pas encore en charge ces signatures agrégées et les refuse explicitement, sans substitution. [Types] DAE F(X,X',t) [residual]: cluster&lt;equations:array&lt;string&gt;,variables:array&lt;string&gt;,derivatives:array&lt;string&gt;,time:string&gt;; Initial Values [initial_values]: array&lt;f64&gt;; Initial Derivatives [initial_derivatives]: array&lt;f64&gt;; simulation parameters [parameters]: cluster&lt;t0:f64,tf:f64,atol:array&lt;f64&gt;,rtol:array&lt;f64&gt;,initial_step:f64,min_step:f64,max_step:f64&gt;; error in [error_in]: cluster&lt;status:bool,code:i32,source:string&gt;; Times [times]: array&lt;f64&gt;; X Values [values]: array&lt;f64,rank=2&gt;; X Derivatives [derivatives]: array&lt;f64,rank=2&gt;; error out [error_out]: cluster&lt;status:bool,code:i32,source:string&gt;

## Types and connection rules

Real f64 coupled systems, not element-wise batch lifting. Vectors are rank 1; matrices and multistate trajectories are actual rank-2 Arrays, not nominal Matrix transport. Values[row,column] is state column at Times[row]. Explicit exception: Linear nth Order Numeric returns only x(t) as a rank-1 Array, without its derivatives. Borrowed Variant user data is opaque to the f64 ODE state profile and may preserve exact common typed payloads, including I128/U128 lexical values, without numeric conversion. No complex transport, implicit batch, dimensional broadcasting or scalar lifting. Formula and FROG Reference are explicitly selected persisted identities sharing one palette artwork. Common connector IDs survive switching instances.

- Type resolution: `custom_resolver`; result expression: `resolve:frog.studio.ordinary-differential-equations.type-resolution@1`.
- Implicit coercion: not enabled by this resolver; individual port policies remain explicit.
- Arrays: accepted; lifting policy: `none`.
- Shape rule: `coupled_state_vector; trajectory_rows_time_columns_state; actual_rank_2_Arrays`.
- Scalar lifting: no.
- Broadcasting: no.

**Input count:** 5; this contract does not enable variadic inputs.

Port order: `residual` → `initial_values` → `initial_derivatives` → `parameters` → `error_in`.
